faqs.question: How big is the gap between what kids and teens are getting versus what they should be consuming every day?
faqs.answer: Children and adolescents aren't getting close to the daily recommendations for DHA or enough choline. While many countries have set RDI’s of 250 mg a day, even the biggest consumers of fish in India get only 50 mg - with vegetarians getting even lesser than that.

faqs.question: Are your Brain Gummies allergen free?
faqs.answer: All Little Joys supplements are allergen-friendly. This means we're free of ingredients that are known to cause allergies. These vitamins are free of - milk, eggs, shellfish, soy, gluten, wheat, fish allergens, peanuts and tree nut allergens (brazil, cashew, coconut, hazelnut, pecan, pistachio, macadamia). We're also Non-GMO and gluten-free. No synthetic colors, artificial flavors or sweeteners.

faqs.question: Why do your gummies have 0 added sugar?
faqs.answer: In case you haven't heard yet, sugar is the new bully on the block. Nearly 66.11 per cent of Indian children exhibit abnormally high levels of sugar in their body, which can lead to lifelong problems with childhood development, mental health, obesity, and more.

faqs.answer: We suggest your child takes one vitamin per day with a meal, either breakfast or lunch, though you may take our vitamin with or without food.

faqs.answer: Yes, we strive to produce the best vitamins in the world and it’s important to us to make sure they are safe and effective. We utilize Third Party Lab Testing for a variety of factors such as vitamin levels, heavy metal content, yeast & mold, and other microbes.

faqs.question: Will these bites stick to my teeth?
faqs.answer: Since our bites are made of fruit, not candy ingredients like sugar and syrups, they do not stick to your teeth like regular gummies.

faqs.answer: They are good for 1 year unopened, but, we suggest you eat them sooner for the freshest taste. After opening, we suggest you consume within 60 days.

faqs.question: When can I see results?
faqs.answer: With regular use and a generally healthy lifestyle, you will start seeing results around 3 months.

faqs.question: How Can I Improve My Child's Brain?
faqs.answer: You can improve your child's brain by providing the right nutrients and vitamins to support brain development and function. Our DHA Brain Health Gummies are specifically formulated to help boost children's memory, concentration, and long-term brain development.

faqs.answer: Our DHA Brain Health Gummies are suitable for children aged 4 years and older.

faqs.question: Does My Child Need to Take a Brain Boosting Vitamin?
faqs.answer: While a balanced and nutritious diet is essential for overall health and brain function, many children may not get all the nutrients they need from their diet alone. Our DHA Brain Health Gummies are a convenient and tasty way to supplement your child's diet with essential nutrients that support brain health and development.

faqs.question: What Vitamins Help Kids Focus?
faqs.answer: Our DHA Brain Health Gummies are formulated with a blend of 8 essential nutrients, including DHA and Choline, which are known to support cognitive function, memory, and focus. Additionally, our gummies also contain key vitamins such as vitamin A, vitamin C, vitamin D, vitamin E, and vitamin B6, which are essential for overall health and wellbeing.

faqs.question: How Can I Increase My Children's Brain Power?
faqs.answer: You can increase your children's brain power by providing them with a healthy and balanced diet that includes essential nutrients and vitamins that support brain health and development. Our DHA Brain Health Gummies are a convenient and tasty way to supplement your child's diet with essential nutrients that support cognitive function, memory, and focus.

faqs.question: What is the Ideal Time to Consume Brain Gummies?
faqs.answer: Our DHA Brain Health Gummies can be taken at any time of the day. However, for best results, it is recommended to take them with food or after a meal to ensure optimal absorption of nutrients.

faqs.question: Are these gummies bad for my child's teeth?
faqs.answer: Little Joys Gummies are made with natural sweeteners and contain no added sugars, making them a healthier choice than regular gummies. However, like all gummies, they can stick to teeth and may contribute to cavities if good oral hygiene isn't followed. For best dental health, don't give more than 1-2 gummies in a day and encourage your child to brush or rinse their mouth after eating.
